Fox Mulder

Sheriff Andy Taylor

Dana Scully

You suppose?

Sheriff Andy Taylor

We tried to administer medical attention, but the boys hauled the bodies away, took them home. They haven't been seen in ten years, so... We suppose they died.

Dana Scully

Have you questioned the men?

Sheriff Andy Taylor

The peacocks built that farm during the civil war. It still has no electricity, no running water, no heat. They grow their own food. They raise their own pigs. They breed their own cows. Raise and breed their own stock, if you get my meaning.

Dana Scully

It is, however, the closest residence to the crime scene.

Sheriff Andy Taylor

Those boys are feeble, agent Scully, and sad. They wouldn't have any idea what you were talking about.

Dana Scully

They could have witnessed--

Sheriff Andy Taylor

Look, this town is my home. I love it. It's quiet... Peaceful. I don't even wear a gun. I've seen and heard some of the sick... And horrible things that go on outside my home. At the same time, I knew we couldn't stay hidden forever, that one day the modern world would find us... And my hometown would change forever. And when I saw... It... In the ground, I knew that day had come. Now I want to find whoever did this. But in doing so, I'd like it if the way things are around here didn't have to change. I know this is iffy bureau jurisdiction, but I didn't know where else to turn. So I called the bureau in pittsburgh, and when I described the victim, they said I should see you.

Fox Mulder

Maybe we should take a look at the victim then.

Involved in an international governmental conspiracy, the Mulder family passes genetic muster. Scully, that child inside is a tragedy. Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder
